requestedIntent: Prevent ACEF agents from entering planning or execution before recording the route/intake decision, explicit ACEF admission, clarifying questions or inferred answers, approved interview brief, and execution approval; require every split child to return to admission instead of inheriting its parent run.
limitations: The gate enforces recorded intake, explicit ACEF admission, post-split re-admission, interview brief approval, and execution approval for newly written typed active runs; it does not prove that the human conversation actually happened outside recorded artifacts.
Existing two-axis-v1 records remain readable for compatibility; new state-writer records use two-axis-v2.
Target repositories must refresh their ACEF installation before this gate is installed there.
